hero.subtitle: Your AI-Powered Smart Kitchen Assistant
hero.desc: Scan your fridge, type your ingredients — get personalized recipes instantly.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to your next meal

steps.title: Scan or Type
steps.desc: Take a photo of your ingredients or type them in Turkish/English.

steps.title: AI Detects
steps.desc: YOLO computer vision identifies ingredients from photos in real time.

steps.title: Get Recipes
steps.desc: Real recipes from Spoonacular & TheMealDB, translated and personalized.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need in your kitchen

items.title: Visual Ingredient Detection
items.desc: YOLO-based real-time detection from photos with confidence filtering

items.title: Text-Based Search
items.desc: Free-form Turkish text input, auto-translated to English for API queries

items.title: Offline Hybrid Mode
items.desc: Local LLaMA NLP suggests Turkish recipes with zero internet connection

items.title: Weekly Meal Planner
items.desc: Schedule breakfast, lunch and dinner for every day of the week

items.title: Calorie Tracking
items.desc: Personal daily calorie goal via Harris-Benedict formula; tracks intake across your meal plan

items.title: Personalized Suggestions
items.desc: Analyzes your search history to recommend recipes based on your most-used ingredients

items.title: Recipe Rating System
items.desc: Rate recipes 1–5 stars; see community average ratings on every recipe

items.title: Smart Shopping List
items.desc: Add missing ingredients with one tap; deep-links to Migros, Getir, Trendyol & A101

items.title: Bilingual Support
items.desc: Full Turkish/English i18n — UI, recipe names, ingredients and instructions all translated

markets.title: Shop Ingredients Instantly
markets.subtitle: Missing an ingredient? The shopping list connects directly to Turkey's biggest online markets.

team.title: Academic Project
team.subtitle: Developed as a senior capstone project
team.desc: EcoChef is a university graduation project developed by Berkay HALICIOĞLU and Emirhan YETGİN under the supervision of Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmet Serkan KARATAŞ, showcasing the integration of computer vision, natural language processing, and modern mobile development.
